title: Nvidia announces NemoClaw, which combines the OpenClaw agent platform with components of Nvidia's Agent Toolkit to add privacy and security controls (Frederic Lardinois/The New Stack)
summary: Frederic Lardinois / The New Stack: Nvidia announces NemoClaw, which combines the OpenClaw agent platform with components of Nvidia's Agent Toolkit to add privacy and security controls — Nvidia's NemoClaw combines the OpenClaw agent platform with components of its Agent Toolkit to add privacy and security controls.
